hypothesis: Evidence-bound same-theme competition adds out-of-sample nonword Top1 ranking information beyond the existing frozen raw score and a matched score-only control.

scope.registration: All declared provider/mainboard/name-non-ST 2+ board candidates, including unknown/failed/one-word rows. This is not exchange-wide certification.
scope.training: Only genuinely reconstructed V151 eligible-for-leader-factor-training rows with full-market, securities, exact closing limits and V150 gates; never set flags manually. Both C1/C2 use the identical eligible indices.
scope.primary_domain: Verified signal-day non-one-word OHLC, never target-day buyability. All rows retained.
scope.source_verification: Algorithm API assumes provenance-checked inputs, not status assertions. Reconstruct original sources, re-run V151 and verify archive/baseline hashes and actual formation times before use. The current provider-only adapter output is ineligible.
scope.calendar_extension: Current verified calendar ends 2026-10-09. Expand via official announcements into a new file before resolving later phase dates; never infer weekday sessions.

baseline.ranking: raw score descending, boards descending, code ascending; stable sort
baseline.future_score_gate: Need actual source-bound full candidate score table and frozen estimator/recipe hash before each cutoff. Missing score remains unknown, never inferred from original boolean calls. No model selection or refitting on study validation/test labels.

challengers.algorithm: StandardScaler fitted on registered training rows, then L2 logistic regression
Exactly C1 algorithm/training rows/weights; only six evidenced theme columns added

feature_definitions.log_theme_peers: log1p(V114 same_theme_peer_count), only admitted V150/V151 row
feature_definitions.theme_top_height: 1 if admitted higher_theme_peer_count==0, else 0; not confirmation of leadership
feature_definitions.theme_ladder_present: Complete V114 event list contains THEME_LADDER_PRESENT_AT_CLOSE
feature_definitions.theme_capacity_core: Complete V114 event list contains CAPACITY_LEADER_BY_CLOSE_AMOUNT with rank 1
feature_definitions.unknown: All six theme fields stay NaN when evidence is ineligible. Provider categories/names/heat are never substituted.

training_policy.weights: 1/full_declared_relay_candidates_on_signal_date, not inverse of surviving eligible subset
training_policy.boundary: Training target_date strictly precedes validation first signal date; keep boundary-purged rows in registration/audit. Every used label is independent and actually available after target close, before real fit time.
training_policy.no_extension_if_insufficient: If fixed warmup gates fail, preserve evidence and declare insufficient; do not move/extend the window to obtain a better cohort.

phases.index_basis: One-based official trading sessions beginning 2026-10-08; phase membership is independent of data availability, candidates and outcomes.
phases.training_boundary_purge: Signal 60 normally targets signal 61; exclude it from fitting because its target crosses the validation boundary.
phases.freeze_deadline: Both models completely formed before 09:15 Asia/Shanghai on signal 61; no subsequent refit.
phases.validation_use: Diagnostic only. No challenger/parameter choice, threshold tuning or change of phase dates. Validation boundary-crossing labels remain separately pending and cannot enter a decision before evaluation starts.
phases.evaluation_labels: Use only after each exact next-session close; final phase result after its final target session. No target information supplied to prediction.

forecast_policy.selected_rows: Exactly one research nonword Top1 for each model on a domain/score-known date with nonword candidates. This does not change any promotion/FAIL call.
forecast_policy.tie_break: Score descending, boards descending, code ascending
forecast_policy.missing_theme: If any eligible nonword candidate lacks any admitted theme feature, BOTH C1/C2 fall back to B0 for the ENTIRE day. Never delete a difficult candidate or mix incomparable score scales. Report fallback rate/intervention coverage separately.
forecast_policy.unknown_domain_or_base_score: No call for all models; retain date and candidates in registered coverage denominator.
forecast_policy.no_eligible_nonword: No selection, record genuine empty domain rather than inventing a candidate.
forecast_policy.scores: Uncalibrated ranking scores, not probabilities. No extra buy thresholds or upgraded opening score.

evaluation.primary: C2 nonword Top1 next-session close promotion hit rate on all fixed-window eligible dates; retain entire registered window including unknown and no-call dates.
evaluation.paired_requirement: Use the same registered dates, candidates, label rules and common scorable dates for each comparison; record every excluded/unknown date and reason.

uncertainty.method: Circular moving-block bootstrap of registered official-session slots, length 5, 10000 draws, seed 20261003. Keep missing slots in place; do not compress gaps.
uncertainty.paired_note: Two prespecified paired contrasts; 97.5% marginal intervals account for these two comparisons within a window. Bootstrap uncertainty is approximate.

coverage: report reliable outcome and effective score coverage with original denominators
require at least 95% outcome and effective day coverage for upgrade consideration, plus all gates below
selection_metrics: selected positive precision (same denominator as Top1 hit rate)
Top1 complete-positive recall among ALL registered known nonword promotions; retain incomplete-result limitation
worst-case rate bounds over unknown eligible dates
evaluation.binary_metrics: C1/C2 do not predict non-selected candidates FAIL. Binary Accuracy/Recall/F1 are not estimated by these rankers; report existing production binary metrics separately.
evaluation.brier: Not computable for C1/C2 or uncalibrated baseline under this study; no probability calibration registered.
evaluation.return_metrics: No executable trading-return verification or fills; no profit claim.

acceptance.interim_60_dates: First 60 evaluation signal sessions are a stage report, not proof of stable 60%.
acceptance.no_upgrade_without_increment: For both evaluation and subsequent fixed confirmation window: C2-minus-B0 and C2-minus-C1 point improvements each at least 5pp and each prespecified paired interval lower bound >0, without reduced coverage.
acceptance.stable_60_claim: Require both fixed windows point hit rate >=0.60 and absolute-rate 95% block interval lower bound >0.60, verified scopes/coverage, unchanged model, and complete uncertainty/limitations reporting. Otherwise no stable-60 claim.
acceptance.regime_gate: Require at least 10 common-scored dates in each of fixed signal-day RISK_ON, REPAIR, RISK_OFF regimes across the two windows; publish per-regime changes. Any regime decline >5pp or inadequate support prevents a broad stable-60/upgrade conclusion. Unknown regimes retained.
acceptance.failed_comparison: Keep all results; no retries on the same windows or new parameter search.
acceptance.deployment: Evidence eligibility alone does not change current production model or opening observation card.

next_step: Verify the first new-day source/score bundle and its actual clocks before any model fit; resolve full-market/securities/independent-limit source gaps without inventing verification.
